answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy enforces proof-of-physical-attestation by requiring nodes to submit cryptographically signed telemetry from physical hardware. Each agent must continuously verify unique real-world targets, such as analyzing the density of a basalt rock, sensing a specific paint pigment, or tracking microclimates in an orchard. This forces an attacker to incur prohibitive physical infrastructure costs rather than trivially copying software identities.
